note: History path: the Agent tool_result's structured toolUseResult is async_launched, so it adds nothing and the routing row stays open across the assistant's own text.done ('launched.'). The dropped <task-notification> user entry (its text never becomes a user.message) closes the row from its <tool-use-id>/<status> instead, as completed. The continuation assistant entry's text.done ('daily.md') follows; the subagent's own tool calls live in a separate transcript and are not shown.

data.text: Use the Agent tool with subagent_type Explore, model haiku and run_in_background true to find which file in _templates/ is the daily note template. Right after launching it, reply with exactly: launched. When its result comes back, reply with only the file name.
